requirement: R8 - a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper

ladder.demotion: Live -> Paper. Not to Provisional: a demoted strategy re-enters at the bottom and passes G03, G04, G05 and G08 again on new data.
ladder.why_one_way: A strategy that was trusted and then stopped is more dangerous than one never trusted, because it has already carried a stake.

status: No strategy has ever reached the live tier, so no demotion has fired. Every trigger is published with the value it would read today so the gate can be inspected before it is needed.

triggers.name: Signal decay
triggers.metric: Two-sided binomial p on the last 50 settled selections, against the strategy's own reference rate

triggers.name: Multiplicity breach
triggers.metric: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p across the current family of strategies
triggers.window: Every strategy graded in the current run
triggers.current_value: family reading if it were live: worst adjusted p 1.0 (would fire)

triggers.name: Out-of-sample break
triggers.metric: Both halves of the evaluation window beat the reference rate
triggers.threshold: Either half at or below the reference
triggers.window: The full graded sample, split in order
triggers.current_value: family reading if it were live: 2 of 18 entries fail the split-half check

triggers.name: Negative return
triggers.metric: Lower 95% bound of the return on investment over settled bets
triggers.reason_if_not: Needs an executable price. The store holds zero rows, so the trigger is armed and cannot fire. It is not evaluated, not assumed to pass.

triggers.name: Drawdown breach
triggers.reason_if_not: Needs an executable price. The store holds zero rows, so the trigger is armed and cannot fire. It is not evaluated, not assumed to pass.

triggers.name: Closing-line value turns negative
triggers.window: 50 settled selections with both an opening and a closing row
triggers.consequence: Live -> Paper, and a review of whether the edge ever existed
triggers.reason_if_not: Needs an executable price. The store holds zero rows, so the trigger is armed and cannot fire. It is not evaluated, not assumed to pass.

triggers.name: Settlement integrity failure
triggers.metric: Every graded row must re-derive from an official final score, and the feed must reconcile with the official standings
triggers.consequence: Immediate demotion of every live strategy; the build aborts before publishing

triggers.name: Look-ahead detected
triggers.metric: A forecast for week w must use only weeks strictly less than w
triggers.consequence: Immediate demotion of every live strategy
triggers.current_value: Every forecast is built only from weeks before the target week

triggers.name: Rule changed after the fact
triggers.metric: The decision rule recorded in code must match the rule the entry was graded under
triggers.threshold: Any change to a rule or a parameter after its window closed
triggers.consequence: Live -> Paper, and the affected record is voided rather than repaired
triggers.current_value: No rule or parameter has been changed since grading began

triggers.name: Source rights lapse
triggers.metric: Written permission to retain and release the material behind a published price
triggers.threshold: Permission lapses, is withdrawn, or was never evidenced
triggers.consequence: Live -> Paper, and the price store is frozen
triggers.current_value: No written consent to retain prices is evidenced

worked_example.explanation: D01 is the trigger a live strategy would meet first. This is what it would read today, on the selections that exist. Read it as a caution as much as a demonstration: the last 50 selections look much stronger than the full 120 for four of the six strategies, which is exactly the pattern a rolling window can mistake for an improvement. D01 exists to catch the move in the other direction, and would fire on the same kind of swing.
